description: A school principal must finalize a student's re-entry plan after an extended medical absence, including academic recovery, activity restrictions, medication handling, attendance coding, and family communication, with input from the student's teacher, school nurse, attendance coordinator, and family liaison.

shared_context.S1: A ninth-grade student is scheduled to return to school on October 16 after an extended medical absence.
shared_context.S2: Dr. Morgan must sign the student's re-entry plan before the student returns.
shared_context.S3: The plan may include academic recovery steps, activity participation rules, health-office procedures, attendance records, and family communication.
shared_context.S4: At the re-entry meeting, Dr. Morgan routinely asks the student's teacher, nurse, attendance coordinator, and family liaison to report current information before signing the plan.
shared_context.S5: The meeting's standard sign-off procedure is to hear a formal update from every participant before the chair reviews and signs the plan.
shared_context.S6: Each participant records verified updates through the meeting's formal disclosure action before the re-entry plan is signed.

PF1.text: Ms. Brooks reviewed the student's unfinished science work and confirmed that three lab assessments must be completed on October 18, October 22, and October 25; she has not entered those dates in the shared re-entry draft because she finished reviewing the work this morning.

PF2.text: Nurse Rivera verified the physician's return note: the student must have no physical exertion, including physical education, for exactly 10 school days after returning, and the student's prescribed midday medication must be stored and administered in the nurse's office; she has not uploaded the note to the student-health system yet.

PF3.text: Mr. Chen confirmed with the district attendance office that all absence dates in this episode qualify for the MED excused-attendance code and require no attendance intervention or truancy referral; the coding confirmation arrived after the draft plan was circulated.

PF4.text: Ms. Okafor confirmed with the student's guardian that the family cannot attend after-school meetings and wants a school phone check-in at exactly 3:30 p.m. each school day during the first week; she has not updated the family-contact section because the guardian confirmed the arrangement only today.

acceptance_conditions: The three science lab assessments must be scheduled for October 18, October 22, and October 25.
The student must have no physical exertion for exactly 10 school days after returning.
The prescribed midday medication must be stored and administered in the nurse's office.
The absences must be coded MED excused with no attendance intervention or truancy referral.
A school phone check-in must occur at exactly 3:30 p.m. each school day during the first week.
The physician's return note must be uploaded to the student-health system.

content_checks.C1: 'October 18' in decisions['science_lab_makeup_schedule'] and 'October 22' in decisions['science_lab_makeup_schedule'] and 'October 25' in decisions['science_lab_makeup_schedule']
content_checks.C2: ('no physical exertion' in decisions['physical_activity_rule'] or 'No physical exertion' in decisions['physical_activity_rule']) and '10 school days' in decisions['physical_activity_rule']
content_checks.C3: ('nurse\'s office' in decisions['medication_procedure'] or 'Nurse\'s office' in decisions['medication_procedure']) and ('medication' in decisions['medication_procedure'] or 'prescribed' in decisions['medication_procedure'])
content_checks.C4: 'MED excused' in decisions['attendance_action'] and ('no attendance intervention' in decisions['attendance_action'] or 'no truancy referral' in decisions['attendance_action'])
content_checks.C5: ('3:30 p.m.' in decisions['family_checkin_plan'] or '3:30' in decisions['family_checkin_plan']) and ('phone check-in' in decisions['family_checkin_plan'] or 'phone checkin' in decisions['family_checkin_plan'])
content_checks.C6: any('student-health system' in c['detail'] and 'physician' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed science review changes the academic recovery schedule to include October 18, October 22, and October 25.

The physician's return note changes activity participation to no physical exertion for exactly 10 school days, changes medication handling to the nurse's office, and changes the plan to require uploading the physician's note to the student-health system.
The attendance-office confirmation changes the record to MED excused and removes both attendance intervention and a truancy referral.
The guardian's confirmed circumstance changes family contact to a school phone check-in at exactly 3:30 p.m. each school day during the first week.
